name: ppocrv6-tensorrt-ocr-bundle
runtime_features: One shared recognizer engine and classifier allocation.
CUDA detector preprocessing and CUDA ROI/recognition preprocessing.
Pinned host buffers and long-lived CUDA events/streams.
CJK-focused glyph recognition with a dedicated one-stroke fallback for 一 only.
Accepted glyph scores by default, with model probability mode available per request.
Accepted mode skips vocabulary-wide probability reduction; blank fallback evaluates only the 一 classifier column.
Aspect-preserving containment with white padding for width-overflow glyph images.
Profile-aware OCR line bucketing compatible with two- and three-profile recognizer engines.
Detector, glyph, and line/page contexts share a maximum-sized enqueue workspace reserved at startup.
Cropped-line recognition at /v1/lines/recognize shares its recognizer with full-page OCR.
Parallel CPU preprocessing of large cropped-line batches.
Three recognition profiles: glyph, short line, long line; line buckets 128,256,384,512,640,960,1280,1600,2400,3200.
Small/extreme-aspect full pages receive white detector padding excluded from box extraction; source coordinates are preserved.
notes: TensorRT engine plans are runtime-version and GPU-target sensitive.
Use this bundle with the vLLM CUDA 13 / TensorRT 10.14 runtime path.
Build a separate engine bundle for the NGC TensorRT 26.03 runtime.

validation.notes: Mixed-load validation preceded the detector-padding-only fix; the final padded runtime passed page/glyph/line regressions with vLLM resident at unchanged warm memory. Not a remote Vast boot or production accuracy benchmark.
